عُرْجَةٌ : see عَرَجٌ. ―
-b2- Also, (TA in this art.,) or ↓ عَرَجَةٌ , like جَدَعَةٌ and قَطَعَةٌ, (TA in art. جدع,) The place, or seat, of lameness, in the leg, or foot. (TA.) ―
-b3- And you say, مَا لِى عِنْدَكَ عُرْجَةٌ, and ↓ عَرْجَةٌ , and ↓ عِرْجَةٌ , and ↓ عَرِجَةٌ , and ↓ تَعْرِيجٌ , and ↓ تَعَرُّجٌ , There is not for me any remaining, staying, abiding, or dwelling, or, as some say, any confining, or place of confinement, [of my beast,] with thee, or at thy abode. (L, TA.) And مَا لِى عَلَيْهِ عُرْجَةٌ, and ↓ عَرْجَةٌ , (S, O,) and ↓ عِرْجَةٌ , and ↓ عَرِجَةٌ , (so in a copy of the S,) and ↓ تَعْرِيجٌ , and ↓ تَعَرُّجٌ , (S, O,) [i. e., as is implied in the S, There is not for me any confining of my camel that I ride, and remaining, or staying, at it: or] there is not for me any bending, or inclining, to, or towards, him, or it. (O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
